CapabilityExecution.description:
Host execution transport, explicitly selected before a capability is published.
宿主执行传输，在能力发布前显式选择。

oneOf.description:
Short cooperative Rust callback executed on the owning VM thread.
在所属 VM 线程执行的短时协作 Rust 回调。

Reliable request consumed and completed by an SDK event pump.
由 SDK 事件泵消费并完成的可靠请求。

CapabilityScope.description:
Scope required from the trusted caller, independent from Lua business arguments.
可信调用方必须具备的作用域，独立于 Lua 业务参数。

oneOf.description:
Available during an ordinary operation or session invocation.
在普通操作或会话调用期间可用。

Requires an explicitly bound session identity.
要求显式绑定的会话身份。

ExecutionBackend.description:
Declared backend; unavailable variants are rejected instead of downgraded.
声明的执行后端；不可用的取值直接拒绝，不降级。

oneOf.description:
Execute in owned Lua VMs inside the current host process.
在当前宿主进程内的受管 Lua VM 中执行。

Reserved protocol identity; no worker backend is advertised yet.
预留的协议身份；目前尚未声明工作进程后端可用。

VulcanPluginCapacityPurpose.description:
Host-selected execution purpose; plugin business arguments cannot select capacity ownership.
宿主选择的执行用途；插件业务参数不能选择容量归属。

oneOf.description:
Ordinary tool invocations keep their declared single-call semantics.
普通工具调用保留声明的单次调用语义。

Controller-owned tool sessions retain one exact VM for their lifetime.
控制器拥有的工具会话在整个寿命内保留一个精确 VM。

Persistent Hook instances preserve their ordering and original shutdown declaration.
持久 Hook 实例保留顺序及原关闭声明。

Transient and persistent UI Actions share limits without sharing Lua state.
瞬时及持久 UI Action 共享上限，不共享 Lua 状态。

Host lifecycle callbacks retain their own capacity across catalog generations.
宿主生命周期回调跨目录代次保留自身容量。

Activation probes consume real initialization resources without a business export.
启用探测消费真实初始化资源，不具有业务导出。

VulcanPluginCapacityRequirement.description:
Minimum host policy needed by one execution purpose, separate from current free capacity.
单个执行用途所需的最小宿主策略，独立于当前空闲容量。

purpose.description:
Exact production purpose whose frozen configuration must satisfy these floors.
冻结配置必须满足这些下限的精确生产用途。

queued_bytes.description:
Minimum acceptable pending-input byte limit, positive and never interpreted as unlimited.
可接受的最小等待输入字节上限，必须为正，绝不解释为无限。

queued_calls.description:
Minimum acceptable pending-call limit, positive and never interpreted as unlimited.
可接受的最小等待调用上限，必须为正，绝不解释为无限。

reserved_resident_vms.description:
Required non-lendable guarantee; zero requires no reservation or prewarming.
必需的不可出借保证；零表示不要求预留或预热。

resident_vms.description:
Minimum acceptable resident limit, positive and not a request to allocate instances.
可接受的最小常驻上限，必须为正，且不表示申请分配实例。

running_calls.description:
Minimum acceptable running-call limit, positive and bounded by resident_vms.
可接受的最小执行调用上限，必须为正且不超过 resident_vms。

VulcanPluginHostCapabilityRequirement.description:
One required registered host contract, independent from permission grants or external service readiness.
单个必需的已注册宿主契约，独立于权限授予或外部服务就绪状态。

execution.description:
Declared core dispatch transport, checked against the actual captured descriptor.
声明的核心分发传输，针对实际捕获描述符校验。

name.description:
Exact namespaced callback name; aliases and alternate names are never probed.
精确命名空间回调名称；绝不探测别名或备用名称。

scope.description:
Required trusted caller scope, independently enforced by core invocation admission.
必需的可信调用方作用域，由核心调用入场独立执行。

version.description:
Exact semantic interface version; a range or a newer version does not implicitly match.
精确语义接口版本；版本范围或更新版本不隐式匹配。

description:
Required compatibility and capacity floors; host policy must satisfy these without being rewritten.
必需的兼容性及容量下限；宿主策略必须满足这些条件，且不能被自动改写。

backend.description:
Required execution backend; unsupported backends are rejected without substitution.
必需执行后端；不支持的后端直接拒绝，不替代。

capacities.description:
Distinct purpose requirements; an empty list explicitly requests no additional resource floors.
不重复的用途要求；空列表明确表示不要求额外资源下限。

core_capabilities.description:
Exact versioned semantic feature names advertised by the linked core, never permission grants.
链接核心声明的精确版本化语义功能名，绝不表示权限授予。

host_capabilities.description:
Exact registered host contracts required for business admission; omission declares no callback requirement.
业务入场所需的精确已注册宿主契约；省略表示不声明回调要求。

protocol_version.description:
Exact embedded core protocol identity, independent from the package manifest version.
精确嵌入式核心协议身份，独立于插件包清单版本。

title: VulcanPluginRuntimeRequirements
